notes: The official SP-DocVQA partitions are used without creating a new random split.
All baseline methods use the same validation questions for comparison.
The test partition remains protected because its answer labels are not included locally.
The BM25 corpus is restricted to the document page associated with each question.
BM25 evidence evaluation uses answer-to-OCR text matching as an evidence proxy because explicit evidence annotations are not available for every question.
The random seed is null because the current baseline runs do not use random sampling or model training.
